CustomField.description: The Triggering Record ID of the API call that failed, copied whole: a record ID, or other text of up to 80 characters, such as an order number from another system. Use this to trace the failure back to its source.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The record that started the API call that failed: a Salesforce record ID, or other text of up to 80 characters, such as an order number. Use it to find where the failure came from.
CustomField.label: Triggering Record ID
